You said you still need help
Ready: check-ins arrive as notifications with answer buttons.
Notifications are off: you would not see a check-in. Turn them on.
Posts a fake check-in notification on this phone with a 20-second deadline. Answer it to try the buttons. Nothing is sent to the server.
The server merges reports from the same device. Reset the identity to send several separate reports from this phone.

This phone becomes a new device for the server:

- the signing key is deleted and a new one is created (new sender id, so reports are no longer merged with earlier ones)
- a new Bluetooth id: nearby phones see a new phone and reconnect
- the server registration is cleared; the new key registers when you are next online
- the heartbeat counter restarts and open welfare check-ins and alarms are cancelled
- your profile is kept and uploaded again for the new device
- held messages and history stay on this phone

Use this for demos only.
